newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Luxembourg BGL 1996 net profit up 12 pct.
newsitem.headline: Luxembourg BGL 1996 net profit up 12 pct.

text.p: 1996 (in billions of Luxembourg francs unless stated)
NOTE - Banque Generale du Luxembourg is controlled by Belgium's Generale de Banque
In a statement, the bank said net interest income remained the bank's largest source of revenue and rose in the year.

"Net commission income showed a significant increase, as a result of stronger customer orientation to invest in securities and the bank's high level of activity in the Luxembourg franc bond market," it added.
Income from financial operations was close to 1995's level.
Banque Generale said that operating costs rose due to investments designed to prepare the bank for the next millenium and the arrival of the single European currency.
Write-downs and provisions remained in line with 1995, it added.
